$schema.description: Path or URL of this file's JSON Schema, for editors.

outputDir.description: Directory for reports, relative to this config file.

seenStore.description: File remembering seen offers, relative to this config file.

name.description: Unique slug naming this saved search, e.g. java-warsaw. Used with --search.

keywords.description: LinkedIn search keywords, e.g. Java Backend Developer.

location.description: Free-text LinkedIn location, e.g. Warsaw, Poland.

postedWithin.description: Only offers posted within this window: <number>h or <number>d.

maxOffers.description: Maximum number of new offers to fetch and judge per run.

profile.description: The kind of work this search looks for, e.g. Java development. Offers are judged against it.

searches.description: Saved searches, each with its criteria and profile.
